sentences.en: From The New York Times, this is The Interview.
sentences.zh: 来自《纽约时报》，这是《访谈》。

sentences.en: I'm Lulu Garcia Navarro.
sentences.zh: 我是露露·加西亚·纳瓦罗。

sentences.en: I've never had an interview quite like this one with Charlize Theron.
sentences.zh: 我从未进行过像这次与查理兹·塞隆一样的访谈。

sentences.en: I came in wanting to talk about her storied career, which began when she was discovered barely out of her teens at a bank in Los Angeles.
sentences.zh: 我带着想聊聊她传奇职业生涯的初衷而来，她的事业始于她在洛杉矶一家银行被发掘时，那时她刚过青春期。

sentences.en: By her late 20s, she'd produced, starred in, and won an Oscar for the film Monster.
sentences.zh: 在她20多岁快结束时，她已经制作、主演了电影《女魔头》，并凭借该片赢得了奥斯卡奖。

sentences.en: While she's been in dark comedies like Tully and big-budget fantasy films like Snow White and the Huntsman, I was most interested in her latest turn as an action star
sentences.zh: 虽然她出演过像《塔利》这样的黑色喜剧和像《白雪公主与猎人》这样的大制作奇幻电影，但我最感兴趣的是她最近作为动作明星的转型，

sentences.en: in films like Mad Max Fury Road, Atomic Blonde, the Old Guard franchise, and her newest film Apex, where she kicks butt again,
sentences.zh: 在《疯狂的麦克斯：狂暴之路》、《极寒之城》、《永生守卫》系列以及她最新的电影《顶点》中，她再次大显身手，

sentences.en: this time while being chased through the Australian wilderness.
sentences.zh: 这一次是在澳大利亚荒野中被追逐时。

sentences.en: While we did talk about her roles past and present, our conversation almost immediately took a revealing turn into some of the most painful chapters in her life,
sentences.zh: 虽然我们确实谈到了她过去和现在的角色，但我们的谈话几乎立刻转向了她生命中最痛苦的篇章，

sentences.en: I think surprising us both.
sentences.zh: 我想这让我们俩都感到惊讶。

sentences.en: That includes her experience growing up in a violent home in her native South Africa, her mother killing her father in self-defense,
sentences.zh: 这包括她在南非老家暴力家庭中成长的经历，她母亲为自卫而杀死了她父亲，

sentences.en: and the repercussions she's lived with ever since.
sentences.zh: 以及她此后一直承受的后果。

sentences.en: Here's my conversation with Charlize Theron.
sentences.zh: 这是我与查理兹·塞隆的对话。

sentences.en: So we're meeting the day after the Oscars, and I was watching your acceptance speech when you won your Oscar for Monster in 2004.
sentences.zh: 我们是在奥斯卡颁奖典礼后的第二天见面的，我当时看了你2004年凭借《女魔头》获得奥斯卡奖时的获奖感言。

sentences.en: And, you know, you're standing on stage, you're tearing up.
sentences.zh: 你知道，你站在舞台上，热泪盈眶。

sentences.en: It's clearly just this very important moment, which, of course, it is for any actor.
sentences.zh: 这显然是一个非常重要的时刻，当然，这对任何演员来说都是如此。

sentences.en: Your mom is sitting in the audience, and you thank her for all her sacrifices.
sentences.zh: 你母亲坐在观众席中，你感谢了她所有的牺牲。

sentences.en: When you look back now, what do you think about that young woman and what was happening at that moment?
sentences.zh: 现在回首往事，你如何看待那个年轻的自己，以及当时发生了什么？

sentences.en: I feel the first thing that came to mind was just, this is something that doesn't happen to girls in South Africa.
sentences.zh: 我觉得脑海中浮现的第一件事就是，这种事不会发生在南非的女孩身上。

sentences.en: Like, you know, it's like, I remember looking at a map, and I was like, God, we're all the way down here.
sentences.zh: 就像，你知道，我记得看着地图，心想，天哪，我们离得那么远。

sentences.en: What's going on up there?
sentences.zh: 上面发生了什么？

sentences.en: I remember, like, feeling very lucky that I made it out here.
sentences.zh: 我记得当时感到非常幸运，因为我能从那里走出来。

sentences.en: And, like, my greatest dream, like, my, like, lottery win would have been to be able to support myself as an actor and not have a second job.
sentences.zh: 而且，我最大的梦想，就像我中了彩票一样，就是能够作为一名演员养活自己，而不必做第二份工作。

sentences.en: Like, that was literally what I was, like, aiming for.
sentences.zh: 那真的是我当时的目标。

sentences.en: And, like, not just aiming for it.
sentences.zh: 不仅仅是目标。

sentences.en: Like, that would have been, I just wanted to, like, be able to support myself, not depend on my mom or a guy, feel secure, and get to do the thing that I absolutely love.
sentences.zh: 那会是……我只是想能够养活自己，不依赖我的母亲或某个男人，感到安全，并能做我真正热爱的事情。

sentences.en: But the thing with my mom is very, I'm going to try and talk about it very professionally because I will tear up.
sentences.zh: 但关于我母亲的事情，我很……我会试着非常专业地谈论它，因为我怕我会哭出来。

sentences.en: She did sacrifice a lot.
sentences.zh: 她确实牺牲了很多。

sentences.en: Yeah, and we're going to talk about that.
sentences.zh: 是的，我们要谈谈那个。

sentences.en: And you can tell just in that moment, you know, the connection, the just looking at each other.
sentences.zh: 在那一刻，你能感觉到那种联系，那种仅仅是看着对方的感觉。

sentences.en: Well, I couldn't look at her.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我没法看她。

sentences.en: I was like, I'm not going to look at you.
sentences.zh: 我当时想，我不能看你。

sentences.en: Like, the first part of the speech, I handled it.
sentences.zh: 演讲的第一部分，我应付过来了。

sentences.en: Like, I was, like, just really excited and shocked.
sentences.zh: 我当时真的很兴奋，也很震惊。

sentences.en: And I was like, do not look at her.
sentences.zh: 我对自己说，不要看她。

sentences.en: Do not look at her.
sentences.zh: 不要看她。

sentences.en: Because I knew that as soon as I looked at her, I was going to feel, I just knew that.
sentences.zh: 因为我知道只要我一看她，我就会有那种感觉，我就是知道。

sentences.en: Because it was somewhat of a shared experience.
sentences.zh: 因为那在某种程度上是一种共同的经历。

sentences.en: Yeah, I can see you getting emotional now.
sentences.zh: 是的，我现在能看出你情绪激动了。

sentences.en: No, I'm not.
sentences.zh: 不，我没有。

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 没有。

sentences.en: I don't know what you're talking about.
sentences.zh: 我不知道你在说什么。

sentences.en: Yeah, yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊，是啊。

sentences.en: It's hard not to because it's so real.
sentences.zh: 很难不激动，因为它太真实了。

sentences.en: You know, I'm a mom now, and I don't have to sacrifice the things like she did.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我现在也是个母亲，我不必像她那样做出牺牲。

sentences.en: So I know what she did, and I'm very grateful.
sentences.zh: 所以我知道她做了什么，我非常感激。

sentences.en: I guess since we started here, we'll talk about the movie, but since we're already talking about your family and where you came from, you grew up in South Africa on a small farm.
sentences.zh: 我想既然我们从这里开始，我们就谈谈这部电影，但既然我们已经在谈论你的家庭和你的出身，你是在南非的一个小农场长大的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Tell me about what you remember about growing up there and what your life was like.
sentences.zh: 跟我说说你对在那里成长的记忆，以及你的生活是什么样的。

sentences.en: I remember very vividly moving to that farm.
sentences.zh: 我非常清晰地记得搬到那个农场的情景。

sentences.en: I was four years old.
sentences.zh: 我当时四岁。

sentences.en: I remember seeing it.
sentences.zh: 我记得看到它的样子。

sentences.en: I remember it being feeling when I was that age, like so vaSt.
sentences.zh: 我记得在那个年纪，它感觉非常广阔。

sentences.en: It really wasn't.
sentences.zh: 其实并没有那么大。

sentences.en: It was like 16 acres.
sentences.zh: 大约只有16英亩。

sentences.en: But it just felt like this like vast because it had, it had, I think they were growing alfalfa on it.
sentences.zh: 但它感觉很广阔，因为那里，我想他们在那儿种了苜蓿。

sentences.en: And one side they were growing corn on it.
sentences.zh: 另一边他们种了玉米。

sentences.en: So it just had this kind of air of, and they had these two big reservoirs on it.
sentences.zh: 所以它有一种……而且那里有两个大水库。

sentences.en: And there was this big, big tree.
sentences.zh: 还有一棵很大很大的树。

sentences.en: And I don't know what tree it was, but it was kind of like it greeted you as you were driving in.
sentences.zh: 我不知道那是什么树，但当你开车进去时，它就像是在迎接你。

sentences.en: And I have very, very vivid memories of this tree and climbing it and climbing it recklessly barefoot.
sentences.zh: 我对这棵树有非常非常深刻的记忆，我曾赤脚鲁莽地爬上去。

sentences.en: And just feeling, it was like a sense of freedom for sure.
sentences.zh: 那种感觉，绝对是一种自由感。

sentences.en: Were you like a tomboy?
sentences.zh: 你当时像个假小子吗？

sentences.en: Were you an athletic child?
sentences.zh: 你是个爱运动的孩子吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: No, I definitely liked adventure.
sentences.zh: 不，我绝对喜欢冒险。

sentences.en: And I liked, I was, when I think back now, my every day was filled with kind of imagination.
sentences.zh: 而且我喜欢……现在回想起来，我的每一天都充满了想象力。

sentences.en: Like, you know, I would go out and go to the garden.
sentences.zh: 就像，你知道，我会出去到花园里。

sentences.en: I would imagine I was a chef and I was gonna, it was always, there was always a story attached.
sentences.zh: 我会想象自己是一名厨师，而且总是……总是伴随着一个故事。

sentences.en: You know, if the dogs came with me, I was like Sheena, Queen of the Jungle.
sentences.zh: 你知道，如果狗跟着我，我就觉得自己是丛林女王希娜。

sentences.en: And when I started watching movies, I really kind of like started interpreting my movies into my everyday life.
sentences.zh: 当我开始看电影时，我真的开始把电影情节融入到我的日常生活中。

sentences.en: So, yeah, I loved adventure.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，我热爱冒险。

sentences.en: I like getting into trouble too.
sentences.zh: 我也喜欢惹麻烦。

sentences.en: You know, I like to do things that I knew I wasn't allowed to do, but I was allowed to do so much.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我喜欢做那些我知道不被允许做的事情，但我被允许做的事情太多了。

sentences.en: Like, you know, crazy.
sentences.zh: 就像，你知道，太疯狂了。

sentences.en: Like to kind of run wild.
sentences.zh: 就像那种肆意奔跑。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: It was, yeah, it was that, that, I mean, I could take my BMX out and go into like the closest little town to go rent movies.
sentences.zh: 那是，是的，那是……我是说，我可以骑着我的小轮车去最近的小镇租电影。

sentences.en: I mean, I would tell my mom.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我会告诉我的母亲。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: But I could do pretty much anything that I wanted to do.
sentences.zh: 但我几乎可以做任何我想做的事情。

sentences.en: Did that make you independent?
sentences.zh: 这让你变得独立了吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Growing up, you just felt like you had the run of the world?
sentences.zh: 成长过程中，你是否觉得世界任你驰骋？

sentences.en: Yeah, I was super independent.
sentences.zh: 是的，我非常独立。

sentences.en: I feel like that's not unusual though.
sentences.zh: 不过我觉得这并不罕见。

sentences.en: I felt like my friends kind of grew up that way too.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我的朋友们也是那样长大的。

sentences.en: I felt like my independence also had to just come from like an emotional place.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我的独立也必须源于情感层面。

sentences.en: You know, my house wasn't always stable.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我的家庭并不总是稳定的。

sentences.en: And so I was, I felt very responsible to like make sure that like I was taken care of.
sentences.zh: 所以我感到非常有责任去确保自己得到照顾。

sentences.en: Like there was this kind of thing that by the time I moved out of the house, I knew how to take care of myself on many levels.
sentences.zh: 就像有一种感觉，在我搬出家门时，我在很多层面上都知道如何照顾自己。

sentences.en: Before we get to what was going on inside the house, outside the house is also a lot of instability.
sentences.zh: 在我们谈论家里发生的事情之前，家外也有很多不稳定因素。

sentences.en: I mean, I was looking at your town and, you know, the mid-1980s in particular were sort
sentences.zh: 我是说，我查了你所在的城镇，你知道，80年代中期尤其是一个……

sentences.en: of a time of violent uprisings against apartheid that led to a state of emergency in your hometown,
sentences.zh: 反抗种族隔离的暴力起义时期，导致你家乡进入了紧急状态，

sentences.en: Bononi.
sentences.zh: 贝诺尼。

sentences.en: There was a lot of state repression, resistance.
sentences.zh: 当时有很多国家镇压和反抗。

sentences.en: I mean, you were a very young kid, but do you remember any of that?
sentences.zh: 我是说，你当时还是个很小的孩子，但你记得这些吗？

sentences.en: Did that sort of play into how you saw?
sentences.zh: 这是否影响了你的看法？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I, you just, you, you couldn't avoid it.
sentences.zh: 你……你根本无法避免。

sentences.en: Like violence and, and turmoil was something that was like everyday life in South Africa.
sentences.zh: 暴力和动荡是南非日常生活的一部分。

sentences.en: If you got in the car, if I went to the bank with my mom, that was something that you just saw on the side of the roads.
sentences.zh: 如果你坐上车，如果我和我妈妈去银行，那都是你在路边就能看到的事情。

sentences.en: And for sure, I, I saw things that I shouldn't have seen at, at a very young age concerning violence because that was just the circumstances.
sentences.zh: 而且可以肯定的是，我在很小的时候就看到了我不该看到的暴力场面，因为环境就是那样。

sentences.en: So there was a lot of talk constantly about apartheid.
sentences.zh: 所以当时关于种族隔离的讨论非常多。

sentences.en: It was a hot topic.
sentences.zh: 那是一个热门话题。

sentences.en: Like you'd go to a barbecue.
sentences.zh: 就像你去参加烧烤聚会。

sentences.en: That's what everybody was talking about.
sentences.zh: 每个人都在谈论这个。

sentences.en: They weren't really hiding it from the kids.
sentences.zh: 他们并没有真的对孩子们隐瞒。

sentences.en: When you say you saw violence, what, do you remember anything in particular?
sentences.zh: 当你提到你看到了暴力，你还记得什么特别的事情吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Oh yeah.
sentences.zh: 哦，是的。

sentences.en: Like vividly.
sentences.zh: 非常清晰。

sentences.en: It's like tough stuff to talk about.
sentences.zh: 这很难谈论。

sentences.en: I was like very young.
sentences.zh: 我当时非常小。

sentences.en: I saw, I saw a man burn inside a car on the side of the road.
sentences.zh: 我看到……我看到一个人在路边的车里被烧死。

sentences.en: God.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: And, and, and a lot of people pulling over and trying to help and not being able to help.
sentences.zh: 而且……很多人停下车试图帮忙，却无能为力。

sentences.en: Um, I also then later, you know, I saw what HIV and AIDS was doing.
sentences.zh: 嗯，后来我也看到了艾滋病毒和艾滋病造成的影响。

sentences.en: Like, I remember people being wheelbarrowed into our house because they knew my mom would take them to a clinic.
sentences.zh: 我记得人们被用手推车推进我们家，因为他们知道我妈妈会带他们去诊所。

sentences.en: You know, you have spoken a lot about the turbulence outside, but also, as you mentioned, inside your family.
sentences.zh: 你知道，你谈了很多关于外面的动荡，但也如你所提到的，还有你家庭内部的情况。

sentences.en: And your father was an alcoholic as someone myself who's, you know, dealt with alcohol abuse in, in our family.
sentences.zh: 你父亲是个酒鬼，作为一个处理过家庭酗酒问题的人，

sentences.en: It is an incredibly difficult thing, especially for a child to deal with.
sentences.zh: 这是一件极其困难的事情，尤其是对一个孩子来说。

sentences.en: When did you realize that your own home life was maybe different than other friends of yours?
sentences.zh: 你是什么时候意识到你的家庭生活可能与朋友们不同的？

sentences.en: That's a good question.
sentences.zh: 这是个好问题。

sentences.en: Um, pretty young, I would say.
sentences.zh: 嗯，很小的时候，我想。

sentences.en: Really young.
sentences.zh: 真的很小。

sentences.en: I have memories from when I was really young, seeing, and it scared me, seeing drunk people, but like really drunk people.
sentences.zh: 我从很小的时候就有记忆，看到……这让我害怕，看到醉酒的人，但那是真正喝醉的人。

sentences.en: Like, people crawling on the floor, kind of drunk, you know?
sentences.zh: 就像，人们在地上爬的那种醉法，你知道吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, and it was scary in the beginning.
sentences.zh: 是的，起初很可怕。

sentences.en: You know, like, I remember vividly, like, seeing my uncle, like, really drunk.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我清晰地记得看到我叔叔喝得烂醉如泥。

sentences.en: And I was, it was frightening.
sentences.zh: 我当时……那很吓人。

sentences.en: It was really frightening.
sentences.zh: 真的很吓人。

sentences.en: But that became so consistent that that that was every Friday, Saturday.
sentences.zh: 但这变得如此频繁，以至于每个周五、周六都是这样。

sentences.en: Maybe even every Wednesday.
sentences.zh: 甚至可能是每个周三。

sentences.en: Like, my dad had built this really big bar inside the house.
sentences.zh: 我爸爸在家里建了一个很大的吧台。

sentences.en: And again, not very unusual.
sentences.zh: 再说一次，这并不罕见。

sentences.en: Like, a lot of South Africans have a, like, they love to kind of create a space in their house where they can drink.
sentences.zh: 很多南非人，他们喜欢在家里开辟一个空间，专门用来喝酒。

sentences.en: And barbecue.
sentences.zh: 还有烧烤。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: But it became kind of the, where he lived.
sentences.zh: 但这成了他生活的地方。

sentences.en: It was where, you never saw him anywhere else in the house.
sentences.zh: 那是他待的地方，你在家里的其他任何地方都看不到他。

sentences.en: You always saw him there in the house.
sentences.zh: 你总能在那里见到他。

sentences.zh: 我只想说，我本来没打算从这里开始谈起。

sentences.en: But because I asked you before the interview if it was okay to talk about it, I guess that's where we've ended up.
sentences.zh: 但因为我在采访前问过你是否可以谈论这件事，我想我们最终还是谈到了这里。

sentences.en: Yeah, and to be clear, I think these things should be talked about, you know.
sentences.zh: 是的，而且要说明的是，我认为这些事情应该被谈论，你知道的。

sentences.en: Because it makes other people not feel alone, you know.
sentences.zh: 因为这能让其他人感到不再孤单，你知道吗。

sentences.en: And I feel like I never knew about a story like that.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我以前从没听说过这样的故事。

sentences.en: You know, when this happened to us, I thought we were the only people, my mom and I, that this was going on with.
sentences.zh: 你知道，当这件事发生在我们身上时，我以为我们是唯一经历这些的人，我和我妈妈。

sentences.en: And now the two of us look at it.
sentences.zh: 而现在我们俩回看这件事。

sentences.en: I've had therapy around this.
sentences.zh: 我为此接受过心理治疗。

sentences.en: She's had, she's also just, she's a tough broad.
sentences.zh: 她也经历过，她只是……她是个坚强的女人。

sentences.en: So part of her is just like, it's part of my life.
sentences.zh: 所以她的一部分想法就是，这是我生活的一部分。

sentences.en: It's not who I am.
sentences.zh: 但这并不代表我是谁。

sentences.en: I'm way more interesting than this.
sentences.zh: 我比这有趣得多。

sentences.en: And, oh, is she more interesting than that?
sentences.zh: 噢，她难道不比那更有趣吗？

sentences.en: So I know she won't mind this.
sentences.zh: 所以我知道她不会介意谈论这个。

sentences.en: So, yeah, it's a good way to, I think, make people not feel alone.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，我认为这是一个让人们不再感到孤单的好方法。

sentences.en: And, you know, I'm not haunted by any of this stuff anymore.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，我不再被这些事情所困扰了。

sentences.en: And, in fact, you've become a campaigner to prevent gender-based violence.
sentences.zh: 事实上，你已经成为了一名预防性别暴力活动的倡导者。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And you've made it an important issue for you.
sentences.zh: 你已经把它当作一个重要的议题来对待了。

sentences.en: And you've been very clear that that trauma does not define you.
sentences.zh: 而且你非常明确地表示，那段创伤并不能定义你。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: It does, though, as you mentioned, find you and your mother, though, and your story.
sentences.zh: 不过正如你所提到的，它确实找到了你和你的母亲，还有你的故事。

sentences.en: How would you say it changed your relationship to her, that moment?
sentences.zh: 你觉得那一刻是如何改变了你与她的关系的？

sentences.en: It's a very good question, because it did.
sentences.zh: 这是一个很好的问题，因为它确实改变了。

sentences.en: It really did change our relationship.
sentences.zh: 它真的改变了我们的关系。

sentences.en: We were always very close.
sentences.zh: 我们一直都很亲密。

sentences.en: We felt like a team.
sentences.zh: 我们感觉像是一个团队。

sentences.en: But that night changed it, because, in retrospect, like, once I got out of the shock of it, I realized that she saved my life, which is a big thing, you know?
sentences.zh: 但那个夜晚改变了一切，因为回想起来，当我从震惊中走出来后，我意识到她救了我的命，这可是件大事，你知道吗？

sentences.en: Oh, my goodness.
sentences.zh: 噢，天哪。

sentences.en: It's the ultimate sacrifice a mother can give.
sentences.zh: 这是一个母亲能做出的终极牺牲。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And then also the aftermath of, like, she picked right up.
sentences.zh: 还有随之而来的后果，她立刻就振作了起来。

sentences.en: Like, she—this is, I think, such a testament to her strength, because the next morning she sent me to school, she was just like, we're going to move on.
sentences.zh: 她——我认为这充分证明了她的坚强，因为第二天早上她就送我去上学，她只是说，我们要继续生活下去。

sentences.en: Not necessarily the healthiest thing, but it worked for us.
sentences.zh: 这未必是最健康的做法，但对我们来说奏效了。

sentences.en: She wanted me to forget about it.
sentences.zh: 她想让我忘记这件事。

sentences.en: She didn't want me to, like, sit in it.
sentences.zh: 她不想让我沉浸在其中。

sentences.en: We didn't have therapists around.
sentences.zh: 我们身边没有心理医生。

sentences.en: It wasn't like she was going to say, like, go see a therapiSt.
sentences.zh: 她不会说，去看看心理医生之类的。

sentences.en: We just didn't have access to those things.
sentences.zh: 我们根本接触不到那些资源。

sentences.en: So in her head, the best therapy was, we got to move on.
sentences.zh: 所以在她看来，最好的治疗就是，我们必须向前看。

sentences.en: We can't, like, sit in this.
sentences.zh: 我们不能沉溺于此。

sentences.en: And did you—I mean, in the sense of, did you, like, lock it away?
sentences.zh: 那你——我是说，你有没有把它锁在心底？

sentences.en: I did, yeah, because there was a lot of shame kind of surrounding it as well, because I felt like everybody knew how bad it was.
sentences.zh: 我确实锁起来了，因为这件事周围也笼罩着很多羞耻感，我觉得每个人都知道情况有多糟糕。

sentences.en: Nobody stepped in to help, but everybody knew.
sentences.zh: 没人插手帮忙，但每个人都知道。

sentences.en: And then there was, like, and, like, I feel like kids had this kind of attitude towards me, like, even though their parents were in the same boat,
sentences.zh: 而且，我觉得孩子们对我有一种态度，即使他们的父母也处于同样的境地，

sentences.en: I knew so many of them and their parents to be alcoholics.
sentences.zh: 我认识他们中的很多人，他们的父母也是酒鬼。

sentences.en: There was this kind of energy that was like, well, yours is, like, really bad, like, that that happened, you know?
sentences.zh: 有一种氛围是这样的：好吧，你家的情况真的很糟糕，发生了那种事，你知道吗？

sentences.en: Not being aware that they were moments away from having the same experience.
sentences.zh: 他们并没有意识到，他们离经历同样的遭遇也只有一步之遥。

sentences.en: Do you think it branded—like, you felt like they judged you and it kind of separated you from them?
sentences.zh: 你觉得这给你打上了烙印吗？就像你觉得他们评判你，这让你和他们之间产生了隔阂？

sentences.en: Yes, and I actually—there was only one time I became violent, and it was a girl had kind of, like, taunted me with it.
sentences.zh: 是的，我实际上——我只有一次变得暴力，那是因为有个女孩用这件事嘲讽我。

sentences.en: And she was kind of walking around telling everybody how she had seen my dad drunk, and, you know, this was something that was super sensitive to me,
sentences.zh: 她到处告诉别人她看到我爸爸喝醉的样子，你知道，这对我来说是非常敏感的事情，

sentences.en: because he would show up at school events really drunk, and it was really embarrassing.
sentences.zh: 因为他会在学校活动中喝得烂醉，这真的很尴尬。

sentences.en: And not that a child—I mean, I know this now, but not that a child should ever take that on.
sentences.zh: 并不是说一个孩子——我是说，我现在明白了，但孩子本不该承担这些。

sentences.en: That's—that has nothing to do with you, but when you don't know that, you make it very personal.
sentences.zh: 那与你无关，但当你不知道这一点时，你会把它看得非常个人化。

sentences.en: I always felt like I had to make excuses for him.
sentences.zh: 我总觉得我必须为他找借口。

sentences.en: I always had to, like, tell some story to soften the edges a little bit.
sentences.zh: 我总是不得不编些故事来缓和一下局面。

sentences.en: And I think I did try to sweep it under the rug, because I also—I hated people feeling sorry for me.
sentences.zh: 我想我确实试图掩盖它，因为我也讨厌别人同情我。

sentences.en: I hated it.
sentences.zh: 我讨厌那样。

sentences.en: I almost feel like that was the worst thing, was, like, that now for the rest of my life, people are going to feel sorry for me.
sentences.zh: 我甚至觉得最糟糕的事情就是，从今往后，人们都要同情我了。

sentences.en: So for the first couple of years, for as long as I could, I would have told this story that he died in a car accident, and that it happened then, three years earlier.
sentences.zh: 所以最初的几年里，只要我能，我就会说他死于车祸，而且是三年前发生的。

sentences.en: I couldn't tell it to my school friends, but by the time I left South Africa, that's the story I told.
sentences.zh: 我无法告诉学校的朋友，但当我离开南非时，我就是这么说的。

sentences.en: Because I just—I didn't want to, like, have people show—I didn't want pity.
sentences.zh: 因为我只是——我不想让人们表现出——我不需要怜悯。

sentences.en: It made me so uncomfortable.
sentences.zh: 这让我感到非常不舒服。

sentences.en: So you end up leaving South Africa.
sentences.zh: 所以你最终离开了南非。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And you're young.
sentences.zh: 那时你还很年轻。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I had just turned 16.
sentences.zh: 我刚满16岁。

sentences.en: Which is amazing.
sentences.zh: 这太不可思议了。

sentences.en: And you go to model initially in Italy.
sentences.zh: 你最初是去意大利做模特。

sentences.en: And I—I just wonder what it was like to be that person at 16 with everything that had happened.
sentences.zh: 我只是好奇，16岁时带着所有发生过的一切，成为那样一个人是什么感觉？

sentences.en: It was amazing.
sentences.zh: 感觉很棒。

sentences.en: Really?
sentences.zh: 真的吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: It was amazing, because it was— I wasn't expecting that.
sentences.zh: 感觉很棒，因为那是——我没预料到会那样。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: Escapism.
sentences.zh: 逃避现实。

sentences.en: Oh, okay.
sentences.zh: 噢，好吧。

sentences.en: I could escape.
sentences.zh: 我可以逃避。

sentences.en: The only thing that was really, really hard for me was knowing that I was leaving my mom behind.
sentences.zh: 唯一让我感到非常、非常难过的是，我知道我把妈妈留在了身后。

sentences.en: Mm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: But she was the one that said, you have to go.
sentences.zh: 但正是她说，你必须走。

sentences.en: Like, you have to go.
sentences.zh: 就像，你必须走。

sentences.en: You got—go.
sentences.zh: 你得——走吧。

sentences.en: Get out of here.
sentences.zh: 离开这里。

sentences.en: Go and make a life for yourself.
sentences.zh: 去为你自己创造生活。

sentences.en: There's nothing for you here right now.
sentences.zh: 这里现在没什么值得你留恋的了。

sentences.en: Mm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: What was it like once you got that opportunity and you were out in the world sort of living it at 16?
sentences.zh: 当你得到那个机会，16岁时在世界各地生活，那是什么感觉？

sentences.en: Yeah, I did well.
sentences.zh: 是的，我做得很好。

sentences.en: Did you feel equipped?
sentences.zh: 你觉得准备好了吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, I was so equipped.
sentences.zh: 是的，我准备得非常充分。

sentences.en: I mean, I knew how to take care of myself.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我知道如何照顾自己。

sentences.en: That's just something my mom instilled in me, my lifestyle instilled in me, my country did.
sentences.zh: 这是我妈妈灌输给我的，我的生活方式灌输给我的，我的国家赋予我的。

sentences.en: Like, you just—you know how to take care of yourself.
sentences.zh: 就像，你就是——你知道如何照顾自己。

sentences.en: You know how to cook.
sentences.zh: 你知道如何做饭。

sentences.en: And even in our school, they teach you how to sew.
sentences.zh: 甚至在学校里，他们还会教你缝纫。

sentences.en: I mean, I know more than my kids will ever know as adults, you know, about taking care of myself.
sentences.zh: 我是说，关于如何照顾自己，我知道的比我孩子们成年后知道的还要多，你知道吗。

sentences.en: And I also had this real drive that I wanted to do it on my own terMs.
sentences.zh: 而且我有一种真正的动力，我想按照自己的方式去做。

sentences.en: Like, I didn't want to go out there.
sentences.zh: 我不想去外面依赖别人。

sentences.en: She had given me a credit card, but I was so determined to do this on my own and to not fail, because I didn't want to go back.
sentences.zh: 她给了我一张信用卡，但我下定决心要靠自己，不能失败，因为我不想回去。

sentences.en: I didn't want to go back.
sentences.zh: 我不想回去。

sentences.en: So I was running from a lot of stuff, and I was happy to escape it.
sentences.zh: 所以我是在逃避很多事情，我很高兴能逃离。

sentences.en: And you come to America, and you're a dancer, and you're studying at the Joffrey Ballet,
sentences.zh: 你来到美国，成为一名舞者，在乔弗里芭蕾舞学校学习，

sentences.en: and you have a pretty serious injury, or— It was a built-up.
sentences.zh: 然后你受了很严重的伤，或者——那是长期积累的。

sentences.en: A built-up thing that you just sort of ended up not being able to dance anymore.
sentences.zh: 那是长期积累的问题，导致你最终无法再跳舞了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yeah, it was like a consistent injury that showed up my knees.
sentences.zh: 是的，那是一种持续性的损伤，出现在我的膝盖上。

sentences.en: I was too tall to be a dancer.
sentences.zh: 我太高了，不适合做舞者。

sentences.en: And by the time I got to Joffrey, I was mainly taking class.
sentences.zh: 当我进入乔弗里时，我主要是在上课。

sentences.en: I think I was in full denial, because I didn't have another plan.
sentences.zh: 我想我完全是在逃避现实，因为我没有别的计划。

sentences.en: I really didn't have a plan for anything after that.
sentences.zh: 在那之后，我真的没有任何计划。

sentences.en: It must have been scary.
sentences.zh: 那一定很可怕。

sentences.en: That was when it got scary, yeah.
sentences.zh: 那才是真正可怕的时候，是的。

sentences.en: I went into, like, my first depression.
sentences.zh: 我陷入了——我第一次抑郁了。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: I lived in somebody's basement.
sentences.zh: 我住在别人的地下室里。

sentences.en: I was renting a room in this basement.
sentences.zh: 我租了地下室的一个房间。

sentences.en: It didn't have any windows.
sentences.zh: 那里没有任何窗户。

sentences.en: And I just remember it was, like, really cold winter.
sentences.zh: 我只记得那是一个非常、非常寒冷的冬天。

sentences.en: And I was living in darkness, like, complete darkness.
sentences.zh: 我生活在黑暗中，完全的黑暗中。

sentences.en: And my mom came over.
sentences.zh: 然后我妈妈过来了。

sentences.en: She was really worried about me.
sentences.zh: 她真的很担心我。

sentences.en: And I'll never forget it.
sentences.zh: 我永远不会忘记那一刻。

sentences.en: We sat on, like, this crappy couch that was covered with a blanket, because it was so disgusting.
sentences.zh: 我们坐在那张破沙发上，上面盖着毯子，因为它太脏了。

sentences.en: And we both had a pint of ice cream, and we were just eating ice cream.
sentences.zh: 我们俩各拿着一品脱冰淇淋，就在那儿吃着。

sentences.en: And she just said, like, you love movies.
sentences.zh: 她只是说，你很喜欢电影。

sentences.en: You were always watching movies.
sentences.zh: 你以前总是在看电影。

sentences.en: Always.
sentences.zh: 总是。

sentences.en: That's all you did as a kid.
sentences.zh: 你小时候就只会做这个。

sentences.en: You watched movies.
sentences.zh: 你一直在看电影。

sentences.en: And then when you started dancing, she's like, newsflash.
sentences.zh: 后来当你开始跳舞时，她就像是说，嘿，有个消息。

sentences.en: You were not a great dancer, but you were the best actor.
sentences.zh: 你不是个出色的舞者，但你是最棒的演员。

sentences.en: Like, you would go on stage, and you could tell the story.
sentences.zh: 比如，你走上舞台，就能把故事讲出来。

sentences.en: She's like, you know how to do that.
sentences.zh: 她就像是说，你知道该怎么做。

sentences.en: And you had not thought about that?
sentences.zh: 而你之前没想过这一点？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 没有。

sentences.en: No, I didn't even know how you went about it.
sentences.zh: 没有，我甚至不知道该怎么去着手。

sentences.en: I had no idea how you went about it, and neither did she.
sentences.zh: 我完全不知道该怎么做，她也不知道。

sentences.en: I mean, it was like, I'll buy the ticket.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，当时就像是，我去买张票。

sentences.en: You'll go to Hollywood.
sentences.zh: 你要去好莱坞了。

sentences.en: And we got the ticket, and I was like, oh, it doesn't say Hollywood.
sentences.zh: 我们拿到了票，我当时想，哦，上面没写好莱坞。

sentences.en: It says Los Angeles.
sentences.zh: 上面写的是洛杉矶。

sentences.en: I mean, that is how naive we were.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我们当时有多天真。

sentences.en: I was thinking a lot about how much you'd experience from 15 to 18, which is this period in which this all happens.
sentences.zh: 我一直在想，你在15到18岁这段时间经历了多少事情，也就是这一切发生的时候。

sentences.en: You have this traumatic event.
sentences.zh: 你经历了那次创伤性事件。

sentences.en: You go to Italy.
sentences.zh: 你去了意大利。

sentences.en: Then you go to New York.
sentences.zh: 然后你去了纽约。

sentences.en: You don't know what you're going to do.
sentences.zh: 你不知道自己要做什么。

sentences.en: Then you come to L.A.
sentences.zh: 然后你来到了洛杉矶。

sentences.en: You get discovered.
sentences.zh: 你被发掘了。

sentences.en: You'd lost a career.
sentences.zh: 你失去了一份事业。

sentences.en: You'd found a career, maybe.
sentences.zh: 也许，你又找到了一份事业。

sentences.en: I mean, most people experience that in one lifetime.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，大多数人一生中才会经历这些。

sentences.en: Did you feel that, that already by the age of 18, you'd sort of gone through this enormous change?
sentences.zh: 你是否感觉到，在18岁时，你就已经经历了这种巨大的转变？

sentences.en: I just remember excitement.
sentences.zh: 我只记得那种兴奋感。

sentences.en: I really, like, once I got, like, out of my dark hole,
sentences.zh: 我真的，一旦我，比如，走出了我的黑暗低谷，

sentences.en: there's something about your naivete that makes you not think about the alternative.
sentences.zh: 你的那种天真让你不会去考虑其他的可能性。

sentences.en: Well, for me, anyway.
sentences.zh: 嗯，至少对我来说是这样。

sentences.en: I should speak for myself.
sentences.zh: 我应该只代表我自己。

sentences.en: But I was— I think that's true of young people generally.
sentences.zh: 但我当时——我觉得年轻人通常都是这样。

sentences.en: You just think, like, anything's possible.
sentences.zh: 你只会觉得，一切皆有可能。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: And nothing bad's going to happen.
sentences.zh: 而且不会发生什么坏事。

sentences.en: And not to you.
sentences.zh: 至少不会发生在你身上。

sentences.en: You know, you just—you think you're invincible.
sentences.zh: 你知道，你只是——你觉得自己是无敌的。

sentences.en: And I had big dreaMs.
sentences.zh: 而且我有远大的梦想。

sentences.en: And I had this kind of clock ticking because I didn't want to go back.
sentences.zh: 我有一种紧迫感，因为我不想回去。

sentences.en: So I was constantly kind of, like, like a hustler.
sentences.zh: 所以我一直像个拼命三郎一样。

sentences.en: But I felt very—I just remember those years very fondly.
sentences.zh: 但我感觉非常——我只是非常怀念那些年。

sentences.en: I was excited.
sentences.zh: 我很兴奋。

sentences.en: I found this, like, really great group of friends.
sentences.zh: 我找到了一群非常棒的朋友。

sentences.en: And I was going out and dance.
sentences.zh: 我经常出去跳舞。

sentences.en: These were all things that I didn't grow up with.
sentences.zh: 这些都是我成长过程中没有经历过的。

sentences.en: You know, in South Africa, you don't go to a club.
sentences.zh: 你知道，在南非，你不会去夜店。

sentences.en: Like, you don't go, like, during— I mean, we had—I don't think— I don't want to—
sentences.zh: 比如，你不会去，在——我的意思是，我们有——我不认为——我不想——

sentences.en: Like, some South African's going to be like, that's not true.
sentences.zh: 比如，有些南非人会说，那不是真的。

sentences.en: But my experience was that there wasn't, like, concerts.
sentences.zh: 但我的经历是，那里没有那种演唱会。

sentences.en: I didn't go to concerts.
sentences.zh: 我没去过演唱会。

sentences.en: And I think even if there were—
sentences.zh: 而且我觉得即使有——

sentences.en: Well, there were boycotts, right?
sentences.zh: 嗯，当时有抵制运动，对吧？

sentences.en: So—
sentences.zh: 所以——

sentences.en: Yes, exactly.
sentences.zh: 是的，没错。

sentences.en: Sanctions kind of, like, stopped that.
sentences.zh: 制裁某种程度上阻止了那些。

sentences.en: But even prior to the sanctions— And I think even if there were, my mom would never let me go.
sentences.zh: 但即使在制裁之前——而且我觉得即使有，我妈妈也绝不会让我去。

sentences.en: Because you'd hear of, like, crowd bombings and things like that.
sentences.zh: 因为你会听说人群爆炸之类的事件。

sentences.en: So this was the first time you were able to really be young.
sentences.zh: 所以这是你第一次能够真正享受年轻。

sentences.en: Yes, yes, yes.
sentences.zh: 是的，是的，是的。

sentences.en: So, in fact, the opposite of what I thought.
sentences.zh: 所以，事实上，这和我预想的恰恰相反。

sentences.en: No, I was, like, dancing until the sun came up.
sentences.zh: 不，我当时跳舞跳到天亮。

sentences.en: And then I would go to auditions and be great.
sentences.zh: 然后我去试镜，表现得非常棒。

sentences.en: Like, I was, like—I had no sleep.
sentences.zh: 比如，我当时——我没睡觉。

sentences.en: I functioned on no sleep.
sentences.zh: 我靠不睡觉来维持状态。

sentences.en: I ate terribly because that's what I could afford.
sentences.zh: 我吃得很差，因为我只能负担得起那些。

sentences.en: But I was so happy.
sentences.zh: 但我太开心了。

sentences.en: I was so happy.
sentences.zh: 我太开心了。

sentences.en: So, this brings me, actually, to your new movie.
sentences.zh: 那么，这其实让我想到了你的新电影。

sentences.en: Because you've been doing a lot of tough roles lately.
sentences.zh: 因为你最近接演了很多硬核角色。

sentences.en: And you are what I consider to be our modern-day action hero.
sentences.zh: 而且你是我心目中现代的动作英雄。

sentences.en: Oh, thank you.
sentences.zh: 哦，谢谢。

sentences.en: Do you consider yourself to be an action hero?
sentences.zh: 你认为自己是动作英雄吗？

sentences.en: I don't know about the hero part.
sentences.zh: 英雄这个词我不知道。

sentences.en: My words.
sentences.zh: 我随口说的。

sentences.en: I'm making a kind of obvious assumption, considering where we've started.
sentences.zh: 考虑到我们刚才谈到的起点，我做了一个显而易见的假设。

sentences.en: But I've heard you just say words like independent, self-sufficient, you know, wanting to do things your own way.
sentences.zh: 但我听到你刚才用了独立、自给自足这些词，你知道，想要按自己的方式做事。

sentences.en: And it, to me, there's just, like, a very clear through line to this version of your career.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，这和你职业生涯的这个版本之间有一条非常清晰的脉络。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: So, why was that something that you were attracted to?
sentences.zh: 那么，为什么你会对这些感兴趣呢？

sentences.en: So, I had had little moments in movies where I had to do, like, an action scene, you know?
sentences.zh: 所以，我在电影里有过一些小片段，必须做一些动作戏，你知道吗？

sentences.en: It was, like, stunt people would come in and it would be, like, oh, we're going to, like—
sentences.zh: 当时会有替身演员进来，然后就像是，哦，我们要——

sentences.en: There was, like, a big fight scene that I had in Two Days in the Valley, my first movie that I ever did.
sentences.zh: 在我拍的第一部电影《山谷两日》里，有一场很大的打斗戏。

sentences.en: But I made the connection pretty quickly to my dance career.
sentences.zh: 但我很快就把它和我的舞蹈生涯联系起来了。

sentences.en: And the thing that my mom said was, in that moment, became very clear to me.
sentences.zh: 我妈妈当时说的那句话，在那一刻变得非常清晰。

sentences.en: The fact that I am—I'm a natural storyteller.
sentences.zh: 事实就是我是一个天生的讲故事的人。

sentences.en: And if I have to do it through my body, I'll do it through my body.
sentences.zh: 如果我必须通过身体来表达，那我就用身体来表达。

sentences.en: If I can do it through my mouth, I'll do it through my mouth.
sentences.zh: 如果我能通过嘴巴来表达，那我就用嘴巴来表达。

sentences.en: And I had missed telling stories through my body.
sentences.zh: 而且我一直很怀念通过身体讲故事的感觉。

sentences.en: You know, you said in a recent interview, I have surgery after every movie.
sentences.zh: 你知道，你在最近的一次采访中说，每拍完一部电影我都要做手术。

sentences.en: You said you wanted to get to the fun stuff.
sentences.zh: 你说你想去尝试那些有趣的事情。

sentences.en: And so, I just have to bring this up before we talk a little bit more about this.
sentences.zh: 所以，在我们深入讨论之前，我必须提一下这个。

sentences.en: Because I actually looked into it.
sentences.zh: 因为我真的去查了一下。

sentences.en: Oh, boy.
sentences.zh: 哦，天哪。

sentences.en: Our whole team did.
sentences.zh: 我们的整个团队都查了。

sentences.en: And we were just—we went down a rabbit hole.
sentences.zh: 我们当时——我们陷入了一个深坑。

sentences.en: After this new movie, Apex, you got elbow surgery.
sentences.zh: 拍完这部新电影《Apex》后，你做了肘部手术。

sentences.en: Two elbow—a revision.
sentences.zh: 两次肘部——一次修复手术。

sentences.en: Yeah, one and a revision surgery.
sentences.zh: 是的，一次手术和一次修复手术。

sentences.en: You also fractured a toe.
sentences.zh: 你还骨折了一根脚趾。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Please fill me in on the stuff that we've missed.
sentences.zh: 请告诉我我们错过了哪些。

sentences.en: While making the old guard, you filmed through injuries and got three surgeries on your left arm afterwards.
sentences.zh: 在拍摄《永生守卫》时，你带着伤拍摄，之后左臂做了三次手术。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Is that right?
sentences.zh: 是这样吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Making Atomic Blonde, you cracked two teeth and got root canals.
sentences.zh: 在拍摄《极寒之城》时，你崩了两颗牙，做了根管治疗。

sentences.en: Yeah, my teeth were replaced fully, yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的，我的牙齿被完全替换了，是的。

sentences.en: Fully?
sentences.zh: 完全替换？

sentences.en: Not my—I have all my own teeth.
sentences.zh: 不是我的——我所有的牙齿都是我自己的。

sentences.en: Even though some people don't believe that, I took care of my teeth.
sentences.zh: 尽管有些人不相信，但我很爱护我的牙齿。

sentences.en: Two in the back, they had to just—they had to remove them.
sentences.zh: 后面的两颗，他们不得不——他们不得不拔掉它们。

sentences.en: They were so crushed.
sentences.zh: 它们被压碎了。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: I'll also say that one of the ones that I left off is that you spent five days in the hospital after laughing too hard watching Borat.
sentences.zh: 我还要说，我漏掉的一件事是，你看《波拉特》笑得太厉害，在医院住了五天。

sentences.en: I didn't quite understand.
sentences.zh: 我不太明白。

sentences.en: Was that like a hernia that you got?
sentences.zh: 那是疝气吗？

sentences.en: Like what?
sentences.zh: 像什么？

sentences.en: So I had herniated a disc in my neck making a movie.
sentences.zh: 当时我在拍电影时颈椎间盘突出。

sentences.en: I landed on my neck, and it was a really severe injury.
sentences.zh: 我摔到了脖子，那是一次非常严重的伤害。

sentences.en: Oh, my gosh.
sentences.zh: 哦，天哪。

sentences.en: I was moments away from being paralyzed.
sentences.zh: 我当时差点就瘫痪了。

sentences.en: It was actually that bad.
sentences.zh: 情况确实那么糟糕。

sentences.en: I landed on a concrete floor on my neck.
sentences.zh: 我脖子着地摔在了水泥地上。

sentences.en: What movie was this?
sentences.zh: 这是哪部电影？

sentences.en: On Eon Flux.
sentences.zh: 《魔力女战士》。

sentences.en: Oh, God.
sentences.zh: 哦，天哪。

sentences.en: And they had to shut the movie down, and I had an injury that everybody was hoping my body could heal.
sentences.zh: 他们不得不停拍，我受了伤，大家都希望我的身体能自愈。

sentences.en: After—I mean, I was on bed rest and doing PT, and—but they were hoping that the disc—I was young enough, and the disc is really soft up there, that my body would absorb it.
sentences.zh: 在那之后——我的意思是，我卧床休息并做物理治疗，但他们希望椎间盘——我还够年轻，而且那里的椎间盘很软，身体会吸收它。

sentences.en: And so they didn't want to just do surgery straight away.
sentences.zh: 所以他们不想直接做手术。

sentences.en: And I think it was a big mistake because I suffered for eight years and had chronic pain, chronic pain.
sentences.zh: 我觉得那是个大错误，因为我痛苦了八年，一直有慢性疼痛，慢性疼痛。

sentences.en: And my neck was—that disc sat so close to all of my nerves that if I did anything wrong with it, anything I didn't like,
sentences.zh: 我的脖子——那个椎间盘压迫着我所有的神经，如果我做错了什么动作，任何我不喜欢的动作，

sentences.en: it would just sit on nerves, and I would just be locked, locked for weeks.
sentences.zh: 它就会压迫神经，我就动弹不得，一锁就是几周。

sentences.en: And I lived my life like that for eight years.
sentences.zh: 我就那样生活了八年。

sentences.en: And so the Borat thing is funny because I laughed so hard that I locked it—I locked that disc into the nerves.
sentences.zh: 所以《波拉特》那件事很有趣，因为我笑得太厉害，把它锁住了——把那个椎间盘锁在了神经上。

sentences.en: And it was actually really bad.
sentences.zh: 那次真的非常糟糕。

sentences.en: I had to like—
sentences.zh: 我不得不——

sentences.en: Yeah, I was about to say, it's not a funny story.
sentences.zh: 是的，我正想说，这故事一点也不好笑。

sentences.en: That's a horrible story.
sentences.zh: 那是个可怕的故事。

sentences.en: It's a funny story now.
sentences.zh: 现在听起来是个有趣的故事了。

sentences.en: I mean, we still laugh about it, but I had to like get flown like on a private plane that night and came back to L.A.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我们现在还会拿它开玩笑，但我当时不得不那天晚上坐私人飞机飞回洛杉矶。

sentences.en: And when I had my first baby, I just said to the doctor,
sentences.zh: 当我生下第一个孩子时，我就对医生说，

sentences.en: I want to have the surgery because I just don't want to live in this place where I have a child and I can't pick her up because my neck is out.
sentences.zh: 我想做手术，因为我不想过那种有了孩子却因为脖子动不了而抱不动她的生活。

sentences.en: And so I kind of like—it was the best thing I ever did.
sentences.zh: 所以我就——那是我做过的最好的决定。

sentences.en: I know a lot of people who've lived with chronic pain, and it's really debilitating and really hard to think about anything else.
sentences.zh: 我认识很多长期忍受慢性疼痛的人，这真的很折磨人，让人很难去想别的事情。

sentences.en: What was it like for you?
sentences.zh: 这对你来说是什么样的体验？

sentences.en: It was horrible.
sentences.zh: 太可怕了。

sentences.en: It's horrible.
sentences.zh: 真的很可怕。

sentences.en: It's constant fear of like, I don't know if I should do that.
sentences.zh: 那是一种持续的恐惧，就像是，我不知道自己该不该那样做。

sentences.en: And I'm like in the prime of my life.
sentences.zh: 而且我正处于人生最美好的阶段。

sentences.en: And then it became so acute.
sentences.zh: 后来这种感觉变得非常强烈。

sentences.en: Like I would just get out of the shower and reach for a towel, and it would lock, and I would be in bed for five days not being able to move.
sentences.zh: 比如我刚洗完澡去拿毛巾，身体就会僵住，然后我就得在床上躺五天，动弹不得。

sentences.en: I think I was so worn down by the end of the eight years that if they weren't going to do it,
sentences.zh: 我想在那八年结束时，我已经精疲力竭了，如果他们不打算做手术，

sentences.en: I was going to like go to a country and get it done where they would allow it to happen.
sentences.zh: 我就打算去别的国家，去那些允许做手术的地方把它做了。

sentences.en: I was that desperate.
sentences.zh: 我当时就是那么绝望。

sentences.en: I was also, you know, I shared with my doctor because I was on a lot of opioids and things like that.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，我跟医生分享过这些，因为我当时服用了很多阿片类药物之类的东西。

sentences.en: I was about to ask.
sentences.zh: 我正想问这个。

sentences.en: And you would think with my dad as well, like the worry of addiction, thank God I don't have an issue with addiction and that I didn't become addicted to them.
sentences.zh: 你可能会觉得，考虑到我父亲的情况，我会担心成瘾问题，谢天谢地，我没有成瘾问题，也没有对它们产生依赖。

sentences.en: But I think back now and I just go like that was just so irresponsible in a weird way with myself, the fact that I was just thinking I can kind of,
sentences.zh: 但现在回想起来，我觉得当时对自己太不负责任了，居然觉得我能……

sentences.en: I would be able to control this somehow.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我能以某种方式控制住它。

sentences.en: You know, if that were my reality, I would then probably not want to throw myself and become an action star.
sentences.zh: 你知道，如果那是我的现实情况，我可能就不会想去冒险成为一名动作明星了。

sentences.en: I would want to protect myself from injury and those kinds of issues.
sentences.zh: 我会想保护自己免受伤害和那些问题的影响。

sentences.en: Why do you think you went in the opposite direction?
sentences.zh: 你为什么觉得你反而走向了相反的方向？

sentences.en: I think I wasn't going to let anything take away from my life.
sentences.zh: 我想我不想让任何事情夺走我的生活。

sentences.en: There's a spirit about me that, and I think some of it maybe has to do with the fact that I experienced so much death early on.
sentences.zh: 我身上有一种精神，我想这可能与我早年经历过太多死亡有关。

sentences.en: I'm very aware that time runs out really quickly and that time can run out as soon as I walk out of this building.
sentences.zh: 我非常清楚时间流逝得很快，而且当我走出这栋楼时，时间可能就耗尽了。

sentences.en: I can cross the street and it's done.
sentences.zh: 我可能过个马路，一切就结束了。

sentences.en: I'm so hyper aware of that.
sentences.zh: 我对此有着极高的警觉。

sentences.en: I live my life every single day like that.
sentences.zh: 我每天的生活都是这样过的。

sentences.en: If I lay in bed one day, I'm like, I am missing a day in my life.
sentences.zh: 如果有一天我躺在床上，我会觉得，我的人生少了一天。

sentences.en: But I was never going to be, I didn't want to live like a safe life because of that.
sentences.zh: 但我从没想过，因为这个原因，我就要过一种安稳的生活。

sentences.en: I mean, I do live a very safe life.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我确实过着非常安稳的生活。

sentences.en: I'm not a reckless person.
sentences.zh: 我不是一个鲁莽的人。

sentences.en: I think people think I am, but I'm not a reckless.
sentences.zh: 我想人们以为我很鲁莽，但我并不鲁莽。

sentences.en: I get scared.
sentences.zh: 我会感到害怕。

sentences.en: I'm not reckless.
sentences.zh: 我并不鲁莽。

sentences.en: But I don't want to, I want to, if I get to be on my deathbed one day, I want to say I did everything that I really wanted to do.
sentences.zh: 但我不想……我想要的是，如果有一天我躺在临终病床上，我想说我做了所有我真正想做的事情。

sentences.en: Let's talk about Apex.
sentences.zh: 我们来聊聊《Apex》吧。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 好啊。

sentences.en: No, I'm not.
sentences.zh: 不，我不是。

sentences.en: I don't know what you're talking about.
sentences.zh: 我不知道你在说什么。

sentences.en: Let's talk about Apex.
sentences.zh: 我们来聊聊《Apex》吧。

sentences.en: Tell me, actually, before I move on, what made you emotional?
sentences.zh: 告诉我，在继续之前，是什么让你情绪激动了？

sentences.en: Because life is so valuable.
sentences.zh: 因为生命太宝贵了。

sentences.en: I think like life is so beautiful.
sentences.zh: 我觉得生命太美好了。

sentences.en: Stop it.
sentences.zh: 别说了。

sentences.en: No, this is not in the interview.
sentences.zh: 不，这不在采访范围内。

sentences.en: You are not putting this in the interview.
sentences.zh: 你不能把这个放进采访里。

sentences.en: It's so sappy and stupid.
sentences.zh: 这太伤感、太蠢了。

sentences.en: It's not.
sentences.zh: 才不是。

sentences.en: It's so stupid.
sentences.zh: 这太蠢了。

sentences.en: It's really stupid.
sentences.zh: 真的很蠢。

sentences.en: But this is, but I feel like I'm getting, I'm getting the real you, which is a person who still doesn't want to like be in touch with their emotions.
sentences.zh: 但这……我觉得我看到了真实的你，一个仍然不想触碰自己情绪的人。

sentences.en: It's so funny because people are always like, they think I'm a tough bitch.
sentences.zh: 这太搞笑了，因为人们总是觉得我是一个强硬的女人。

sentences.en: You know, like I think a lot of people think I'm like very cold because I come across as like self-affirmed.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我想很多人觉得我很冷漠，因为我表现得很有主见。

sentences.en: Like I can take care of myself.
sentences.zh: 就像我能照顾好自己一样。

sentences.en: Like I don't need, like, and I'm also, I'm sometimes a little brash.
sentences.zh: 就像我不需要……而且，我有时还有点鲁莽。

sentences.en: And I think people take that as she's so tough.
sentences.zh: 我觉得人们把这理解为她很强硬。

sentences.en: Like she's so cold.
sentences.zh: 就像她很冷漠一样。

sentences.en: And it's the complete opposite.
sentences.zh: 但事实恰恰相反。

sentences.en: My kids are so embarrassed by me because I will cry at the drop of a hat.
sentences.zh: 我的孩子们因为我动不动就哭而感到尴尬。

sentences.en: My kids are always like, stop crying.
sentences.zh: 我的孩子们总是说，别哭了。

sentences.en: So I have access.
sentences.zh: 所以我很有共情能力。

sentences.en: And I think it's, not to be like, but I think it's why I'm okay at acting.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这……不是自夸，但我觉得这就是我演戏还不错的原因。

sentences.en: I can go, I can go to those places very easily.
sentences.zh: 我可以很容易地进入那些情绪状态。

sentences.en: As you can tell, I get, I have like an ability to really feel deeply.
sentences.zh: 如你所见，我有能力去深刻地感受。

sentences.en: Sometimes like, you know, it's not nice, but it works for my job and it works in my life.
sentences.zh: 有时，你知道，这并不好受，但它对我的工作和生活都有帮助。

sentences.en: Like I really, I appreciate, I do appreciate things.
sentences.zh: 我真的很……我很感激，我确实很感激这些事情。

sentences.en: And I'm not perfect at that every day, but I aim for that definitely.
sentences.zh: 我每天都做得不够完美，但我绝对在朝着这个方向努力。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: I was just wondering what you think about being a woman in an action role.
sentences.zh: 我只是想知道你对作为女性出演动作角色有什么看法。

sentences.en: Because in this particular film, the tension doesn't only come from the thrills, and I don't want to give too much away, and, you know, you and sort of physical extremes.
sentences.zh: 因为在这部电影里，紧张感不仅来自惊险场面，我不想剧透太多，而且，你知道，你和那种身体极限。

sentences.en: It also comes through you as a woman feeling threatened, as many women feel threatened, by the circumstances around you, whether there are men who are actually wishing you ill
sentences.zh: 它也来自你作为一个女性感到的威胁，正如许多女性所感受到的那样，来自你周围的环境，无论是有男人真的对你不怀好意，

sentences.en: or is a wild animal going to come and overpower you.
sentences.zh: 还是有野生动物要来压制你。

sentences.en: Do you think female action heroes get dramatic tension or need to get dramatic tension from other sources than men?
sentences.zh: 你认为女性动作英雄是否能从男性以外的来源获得戏剧张力，或者需要获得戏剧张力？

sentences.en: For sure, yeah.
sentences.zh: 当然，是的。

sentences.en: I think it's hard for some men to understand that when we go down into a parking garage, it's one of the most frightening.
sentences.zh: 我认为有些男人很难理解，当我们走进停车场时，那是让人最害怕的事情之一。

sentences.en: I mean, for me, it is.
sentences.zh: 我是说，对我来说是这样。

sentences.en: Like, especially at night.
sentences.zh: 特别是在晚上。

sentences.en: Like, I get, like, a horrible feeling in, like, one of those, like, deep parking garages and underground parking lots.
sentences.zh: 就像，我在那些深层的停车场和地下停车场里，会有一种可怕的感觉。

sentences.en: I mean, I'm constantly looking over my shoulder, and then I'm trying to get into my car as quick as possible.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我一直在回头看，然后尽量以最快的速度钻进车里。

sentences.en: I don't know how many men think about that.
sentences.zh: 我不知道有多少男人会想到这一点。

sentences.en: We just have a different mindset, for sure.
sentences.zh: 我们的心态确实不同。

sentences.en: I think we have to.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们必须如此。

sentences.en: And that's what makes us interesting.
sentences.zh: 而这正是让我们变得有趣的原因。

sentences.en: And that's what makes us, I think, interesting action stars or action subjects.
sentences.zh: 我认为这正是让我们成为有趣的动作明星或动作题材的原因。

sentences.en: You know, I think we attack action differently.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我觉得我们处理动作戏的方式不同。

sentences.en: You know, we can't fight like men, but that doesn't mean we can't fight.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们不能像男人那样打架，但这并不意味着我们不能打架。

sentences.en: So our tagline on Atomic Blonde was always, fight like a girl.
sentences.zh: 所以《极寒之城》的标语一直是，像女孩一样战斗。

sentences.en: Because that's good.
sentences.zh: 因为那很好。

sentences.en: That's good.

sentences.en: Fight like a girl.

sentences.en: It's different.
sentences.zh: 这是不同的。

sentences.en: I don't ever aspire to go into these movies trying to, like, outdo, you know, the male counterpart.
sentences.zh: 我从来没有想过要通过这些电影去试图超越男性对手。

sentences.en: Like, I was sitting opposite Taron, and I was, like, he was working out.
sentences.zh: 就像我坐在塔伦对面，我当时想，他在锻炼。

sentences.en: So I was, like, there's no way.
sentences.zh: 所以我当时想，没门。

sentences.en: You would totally overpower me.

sentences.en: This is your co-star.

sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I was, like, he would totally overpower me.

sentences.en: So we have to, like, figure out other things.

sentences.en: Like, maybe under certain circumstances, by element of surprise, I could do it.
sentences.zh: 比如，在某些情况下，通过出其不意，我或许能做到。

sentences.en: But I'm a bit of a stigler for reality, like, when I make movies.

sentences.en: Like, I want to know that you can really do something.
sentences.zh: 我想知道你是否真的能做到某件事。

sentences.en: Like, I'm always kind of, like, on everybody's back.
sentences.zh: 我总是有点盯着每个人。

sentences.en: Like, can that happen?

sentences.en: But what would happen?

sentences.en: I want to see that happen because I don't believe that.

sentences.en: Like, I want to go in there and believe it.
sentences.zh: 我想走进电影院去相信它。

sentences.en: So I like kind of attacking action movies in that sense, that I want to make something that feels very realistic.
sentences.zh: 所以我喜欢以那种方式处理动作电影，我想制作出感觉非常真实的东西。

sentences.en: I'm not playing superheroes.

sentences.en: In 2017, I interviewed David Leitch, who directed you in Atomic Blonde.
sentences.zh: 2017年，我采访了执导《极寒之城》的大卫·雷奇。

sentences.en: And something he said to me was that, indeed, it's different to fight as a woman.
sentences.zh: 他对我说的其中一件事是，确实，作为女性去战斗是不同的。

sentences.en: And he is obviously someone whose background is in being a stuntman.
sentences.zh: 而且他显然是一个有特技演员背景的人。

sentences.en: And he said it's not about punching with brute force, but it's about using leverage.
sentences.zh: 他说这不关乎蛮力出拳，而是关乎如何运用杠杆原理。

sentences.en: It's just a different way to engage in physical conflict.
sentences.zh: 这只是参与肢体冲突的一种不同方式。

sentences.en: Can you fight in real life?
sentences.zh: 你在现实生活中会打架吗？

sentences.zh: 你现在觉得自己能把别人制服吗？

sentences.en: So there's that part of my brain that always—
sentences.zh: 所以我大脑里总有那么一部分——

sentences.en: It's about defending yourself.
sentences.zh: 这关乎自我防卫。

sentences.en: Yes, and I also think just given my history, I'm hyper-aware, like, of those things.
sentences.zh: 是的，而且我认为鉴于我的过往经历，我对这些事情非常敏感。

sentences.en: Little things like fight with your elbows.

sentences.en: Oh, weirdly, see, that's maybe why my elbows are so busted.
sentences.zh: 哦，奇怪的是，你看，这可能就是为什么我的手肘伤痕累累的原因。

sentences.en: We're getting to some stuff here.
sentences.zh: 我们正在触及一些核心内容了。

sentences.en: But in general, we have a lot of force in our elbows, and we can swing really hard from our elbows, not so much from our wrists.
sentences.zh: 但总的来说，我们的手肘力量很大，我们可以从手肘处发力猛挥，而不是靠手腕。

sentences.en: So, you know, coming forward with your finger.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，用手指（指关节）向前攻击。

sentences.en: Yeah, but this is a full-force arm move, and it can take somebody down if you hit it in the right way.
sentences.zh: 是的，但这是一种全身发力的手臂动作，如果你击打得当，是可以制服某人的。

sentences.en: I feel like I'm scrappy.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我挺好斗的。

sentences.en: I'm scrappy, and I'm a survivor, and I feel like sometimes that's the thing that sets you apart from actual skill.
sentences.zh: 我很好斗，也是个幸存者，我觉得有时候这正是让你区别于纯粹技巧的东西。

sentences.en: You know, I think there are people that would probably take somebody down way better than I can, but if my life depended on it, I'm going to bet on me.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我认为有些人可能比我更擅长制服别人，但如果事关生死，我会赌自己赢。

sentences.en: All right, well, we're going to speak again, but thank you for your honesty and also for engaging with me.
sentences.zh: 好的，我们之后还会再聊，但感谢你的坦诚，也感谢你与我的交流。

sentences.en: And then, you know, I go home and I'm like, oh, I shared too much.

sentences.en: The stakes are really high for someone like you.

sentences.en: I feel like when we were talking, I was thinking about this yesterday, when we were talking, and by the way, your conversation is so natural, so I want to thank you for that too.
sentences.zh: 我觉得当我们交谈时，我昨天还在想这件事，当我们交谈时，顺便说一句，你的谈话非常自然，所以我也想为此感谢你。

sentences.en: And it made me think about things that I haven't thought about in a while.
sentences.zh: 这让我思考了一些我很久没想过的事情。

sentences.en: But I had a thought that I don't feel like we talked about,
sentences.zh: 但我有一个想法，我觉得我们还没谈到，

sentences.en: and that is that, you know, the opposite is so true of my life and of South Africa, the country that I grew up in.
sentences.zh: 那就是，你知道，我的人生和我成长的国家南非，情况恰恰相反。

sentences.en: And I think we covered the hardship, but I really truly feel blessed that I came from there, that I was born there, that I have that soil and my bones.
sentences.zh: 我想我们已经谈到了苦难，但我真的感到很幸运，我来自那里，我出生在那里，我的骨子里有那片土地的印记。

sentences.en: I feel like I'm from there.

sentences.en: And the reason I do is because they're the most resilient, beautiful people that you will ever meet.
sentences.zh: 我之所以这么说，是因为他们是你所能见过的最坚韧、最美好的人。

sentences.en: And they've been through all this hardship, but they have literally come out on the other side with hope.

sentences.en: And it's when I go there, that's the most incredible thing to see.

sentences.en: It's truly the most beautiful country that I've ever been to, and I've been lucky enough to travel a lot.
sentences.zh: 它确实是我去过的最美丽的国家，而且我很幸运去过很多地方旅行。

sentences.en: And it's a place filled with joy.
sentences.zh: 那是一个充满欢乐的地方。

sentences.en: And so I just wanted to kind of talk a little bit about that, because that is such an important part of the one side that we covered yesterday.
sentences.zh: 所以我只是想谈谈这一点，因为这是我们昨天讨论的一个侧面中非常重要的一部分。

sentences.en: It's not all doom and gloom, you know?
sentences.zh: 并不是一切都那么绝望和阴暗，你知道吗？

sentences.en: Sometimes that's the way it goes.
sentences.zh: 有时候事情就是这样。

sentences.en: But that's why this is good, because you kind of get to reflect, right?
sentences.zh: 但这就是为什么这很好，因为你有机会反思，对吧？

sentences.en: And that doesn't happen usually in interviews.
sentences.zh: 这在采访中通常不会发生。

sentences.en: So I'm grateful for that.

sentences.en: So I know in our first interview, we talked a lot about your personal life.

sentences.en: So I want to talk about some of your work.
